Come see Steel Pulse live on the outdoor stage as part of the French Broad River Brewery Summer Concert Series!
Bearing witness to the accelerating negativity of global affairs, British reggae powerhouse Steel Pulse exemplify musical vengeance to halt the disarray of humanity. Hailing from Birmingham, England, Steel Pulse emerged in 1975 with music that provokes thought toward global unification. Songs like “Chant a Psalm” have landed on Rolling Stone’s Top 200 Best Songs list of the 1980s, and the six-time Grammy nominated group won the Grammy Award for Best Reggae Album for Babylon the Bandit. Lead singer and guitarist, David Hinds’ creativity, human persona, and visionary views are revealed through inspiring compositions that capture the effects of the African Diaspora. item.title: shut in 10.5 mile cardio hike — Sat Jul 25, 8:30 AM
item.description:
The Asheville Hiking Group meet/ park at the river park WE HIKE AT A FAST PACE WITHOUT BREAKS. This is primarily a fitness oriented event. While we try to stay together as a group, we will not wait for extended periods at intersections. Sometimes a bit of trail running can even be involved. If you haven't hiked with this fitness group before and are unsure of your abilities, be prepared and know your way back to your car. If carpooling is involved please do so appropriately, or drive yourself to the trailhead.
HIKE DESCRIPTION:
Dogs Welcome. The hike is an out & back 10.5 mile LEVEL 7\* fitness hike that begins at the Bent Creek river park where we take a short connector trail to the MST (Mountain to Sea Trail) South, to the Sleepy Gap overlook, and back. The out hike has 3 steep climbs and for those who desire an additional climbing challenge, a spur trail of 400+ feet elevation is available that rejoins the regular MST trail at Sleepy Gap. item.title: MST: Blackstock Knob, mile-high hike — Mon Jul 27, 8:30 AM
item.description:
The Asheville Hiking Group This is one of the most beautiful hikes along the MST in WNC. It starts in a light-filled hardwood forest and works it way up to a dark conifer forest full of spruce/fir, mosses, and ferns. Helene has cleared the top at Blackstock Knob, which offers good long-range views.
**THIS IS A DARN TOUGH HIKE**. It starts at 5,400 ft., climbs to 6,200 ft., descends to 5,800 ft. at Rainbow Gap, and then climbs to 6,300 ft to Blackstock Knob. **It's 7 miles round trip**. The first 2 miles are through the Rock Pile, after which the trails becomes a bit easier. After our break at the top, we return to the Rock Pile. Not a dog friendly hike.
**THIS IS A CAR POOL**. Parking is severely limited at the trail head, which is at the road up to Mt. Mitchell, NC 128. We will meet at the Folk Art Center, lower parking lot.
It takes 50-60 minutes to reach the trail head, 3 1/2 to 4 hrs. to hike, 50-60 minutes to return. Total time: 5 1/2 to 6 hrs. **Speed limit on the BRP is now 3

item.title: Asheville Crokinole Club — Tue Jul 28, 6:00 PM — Taproom At Highland Brewing Co.
item.description:
Crokinole Tuesdays at Highland Brewing Taproom Join us every Tuesday in the Taproom for an evening of flicks, strategy, and friendly competition! We’re hosting the Asheville Crokinole Club—a community of players who love this classic dexterity board game. Never played? No problem! Crokinole is easy to learn and endlessly fun. Players take turns flicking wooden discs across a circular board, aiming for the high-scoring center zones. The twist? If your opponent has discs on the board, you must hit one—miss, and your piece is out! Whether you’re a seasoned pro or just curious, come grab a pint, meet new friends, and test your skills.
Source: Highland Brewing

**Rating**: Moderate **Elevation**: 800 **Distance**: 5 miles **Surface**: Trail **Pace**: 3 mph **Dogs**: on leash. **Gear**: Long pants recommended, bug spray, water. The ticks are bad on this trail. Bring your bug spray ! **Features**: wooded trail, interesting plants and fungi. Bears are shy, but we may see them, also deer and squirrels. 3 miles uphill, 2.25 down. **All Trails Route**: [Scott Mountain Loop on AllTrails](https://www.alltrails.com/explore/map/scott-mountain-loop-4217403?p=-1&sh=ifwm3x)

item.title: Guided Masterclass: The Modern Remote Job Hunt — Wed Jul 29, 7:00 PM
item.description:
AVL Digital Nomads **Ditch the spray-and-pray. Build a search process that actually works.** Let's be honest. The remote job hunt in 2026 is broken. Ghost listings that were never real. AI gatekeepers screening you out before a human ever sees your name. A hundred applicants for every "flexible" role that isn't secretly a scam. If you feel like you're shouting into a void, you're not imagining it.
You don't need more job boards. You need a system.
Join Michelle Coulson ([Remote Rebellion](https://www.remoterebellion.com/)), Jim Coughlin ([Remotivated](http://remotivated.com)), and host Ric Pratte for a guided masterclass that will change how you search for good. This isn't generic advice about tweaking your resume font. It's the real playbook: how to get referred into private networks before roles ever go public, how to use AI as your edge instead of your enemy, and how to stop wasting energy on jobs you don't even want.
